title: Aurora Throttle Tuner: compact control surface for Dedicated GPU pool scaling and burst
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and prototype a compact, operator-friendly control surface for Dedicated GPU pools that combines health signals, autoscale policy editing, and burst controls into a single, context-aware panel. Goal: let platform engineers and SREs quickly diagnose pool health, tune autoscaling hysteresis, and create one-click burst plans while seeing estimated cost and latency impact.
background: Current Dedicated Pool views are fragmented: metrics live in a full telemetry canvas, autoscale rules are under a separate policy editor, and burst controls are buried in an ops drawer. Customers asked for a compact, single-surface workflow during incident triage and pre-production tuning. This ticket scopes the UX pattern and high-fidelity prototype for validation with Solutions and two pilot customers.
design_goals: Single-pane triage: combine top-level health indicators with quick edit controls
Make cost/latency impact visible before applying changes
Offer safe presets (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) and an advanced editor
Surface fallback behaviors and rollout safety (canary, gradual ramp, auto-revert)
Support both human overrides and scheduled burst events
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates a compact control surface (<480px wide) embedded in pool detail
Users can edit min/max capacity, target utilization, and burst budget from the panel
Cost estimate and expected p95 latency delta are shown for each change before apply
Preset templates available with one-click apply and an advanced JSON policy link
QA checklist for accessibility and keyboard-only controls is satisfied
technical_considerations: Cost estimates derived from per-pool token-rate projection + reserved commit amortization (backend work: ENG-28421)
Latency delta approximations use historical p95 regression models and a lightweight simulator (ENG-28990)
Presets translate to concrete autoscaler configs (hysteresis windows, cooldowns, step sizes)
Panel must fetch health signals at a lower cadence (5s) than full telemetry (1s) to avoid overload
decisions: Compact panel will be docked in pool detail header and open as an overlay to reduce navigation cost
Show both relative (%) and absolute (GPU count, vCPU equivalent) values for clarity
Presets will be immutable templates; applying them generates a named policy revision for audit
Burst events will be scheduled with explicit budget and automatic rollback conditions
open_questions: Do we support editing node type/shape from the panel or only capacity knobs? (ask infra team)
How to surface multi-tenant cost allocation when a pool is shared across customers? (PM input needed)
Should we allow immediate forced scale (hot fix) or require canary ramp for safety?
tasks: Finalize high-fidelity screens and annotate interactions (Aisha)
Build clickable prototype and link telemetry toggles (Design Eng handoff)
Review cost estimation algorithm with Pricing team (PM)
Run 3 moderated usability tests with SRE participants and capture failure modes
Engineering: spike implementation for cost/latency simulator (ENG-28990)
Create acceptance QA checklist and keyboard/accessibility tests
notes: Usability hypothesis: operators can triage and apply safe bursts 50% faster with a consolidated panel
We intentionally keep advanced JSON editor one click away to avoid overwhelming first-time users
Design iteration v2 introduces an inline confidence bar showing simulator certainty (low/med/high)
reviews: PM Review (Kiran Desai): prefers stronger guardrails on aggressive presets; requested explicit cost dollar estimate
Engineering Review (Ruth Kim): flagged backend telemetry cadence and cost compute load; suggested caching policy
Security Review (Rahul Mehta): no direct sensitive surface but requested audit trail for manual overrides
review_feedback_actions: Add a per-change dollar cost preview and cumulative 24h projection
Introduce a 'dry-run' toggle that runs the simulator and returns expected traces without changing config
Persist a detailed audit event for every manual override and scheduled burst action
next_steps: Incorporate feedback into v2 mockups and ship prototype to pilot accounts (by 2026-03-19)
Coordinate with ENG-28421 spike to expose cost estimator API endpoints
Schedule usability tests with two pilot customer SRE teams and Solutions Engineers
